evidence: Carries the P2P label and heavily modifies net_processing and P2P protocol handling with dedicated stale tip relay managers.
rationale: Implements block serving and fetching for BIP 332 (Stale Tip Relay) on top of header-only relay. Introducing `-staletips=blocks` with a dedicated best-effort schedule enables nodes to inspect stale-branch transactions without risking peer disconnections from standard block sync expectations, providing substantial strategic value for P2P network observability.
